title: Race results
description: The object returned by Game.getResults() (public/display/engine/Game.js). All plain data, fresh objects. Rows are sorted by race order: finished cars first by finish time, then live cars by race position. Removed (forfeited) cars are absent entirely. Consumed by the standings/results boards and Grand Prix points. See docs/native-port/contract.md.

playerId.description: Car id (peerIndex, or strings like 'ai-N'/'cpu-x' for bots).

rank.description: 1-based and dense: equals index + 1 in this sorted array. Indexes Grand Prix POINTS_BY_RANK.

finished.description: false = DNF or still racing when the failsafe timeout ended the race.

time.description: Finish time in seconds of simulated race time, or null when not finished.
